hero.headline: Your Journey, Your Choice.
hero.subline: Explore Sri Lanka with absolute freedom and comfort. Premium vehicles, instant driving permits, and 24/7 dedicated support — all customized for your perfect road trip.

trustBar.title: Comprehensive Insurance
trustBar.desc: Full Rent-a-Car coverage included for total peace of mind

trustBar.title: Full Fuel Tank
trustBar.desc: Start your journey immediately with a full tank of fuel provided

trustBar.title: 24-Hour Rental Cycle
trustBar.desc: Flexible full 24-hour daily rental billing from pickup time

trustBar.title: Instant Reservation

howItWorks.title: Choose Your Ideal Vehicle
howItWorks.desc: Select from our fleet of clean scooters, automatic cars, luxury SUVs or vans.

howItWorks.title: Lock In Your Reservation
howItWorks.desc: Pay a small advance deposit (Bike Rs. 1,000 / Car or Van Rs. 2,000) to confirm.

howItWorks.title: Quick Verification
howItWorks.desc: Submit your valid Driving License, NIC/Passport & official ID documents.

howItWorks.title: Take the Wheel & Drive
howItWorks.desc: Collect your keys in Peradeniya/Kandy or request hotel delivery!

documentsAndDeposit.licenseRequirement: Valid Driving License (Sri Lankan License or International Driving Permit - IDP)
documentsAndDeposit.idRequirement: National Identity Card (NIC) / Passport + Official ID Verification
documentsAndDeposit.depositInfo: Refundable security deposit returned upon drop-off (Bikes: Rs. 5,000 | Cars: Rs. 10,000 - Rs. 20,000 | Vans: Rs. 15,000).

whyChooseUs.title: Prime Location Access
whyChooseUs.desc: Convenient pickup and drop-off close to Peradeniya Railway Station & Kandy City Center.

whyChooseUs.title: Transparent Pricing
whyChooseUs.desc: Zero hidden charges. Clear daily rates with generous kilometer allowances.

whyChooseUs.title: Pristine & Maintained Fleet
whyChooseUs.desc: Every vehicle is thoroughly sanitized and safety checked before delivery.

whyChooseUs.title: 24/7 Road Assistance
whyChooseUs.desc: Direct WhatsApp & phone line active anytime you need support during your journey.
